desc:
Respect for Real Life | Saudi Grand Roleplay

Live your life in a realistic Saudi city inspired by Riyadh (Al-Malqa district): streets, neighborhoods, an international road, and an open park.

• Military and Police: Work as a soldier, patrol officer, SWAT, in pursuits, at checkpoints, arresting suspects, and in the central prison.
• Emergency Services & Jobs: Paramedic, Taxi Driver, Delivery, and a Job Office that gathers all available positions.
• Cars: Over 70 vehicles, a garage and showroom, modification and paint shop, rims, Saudi license plates, and gasoline.
• Drifting and street racing: Free drifting, 360-degree spins, and street racing arenas.
• Camping and wilderness: camps, nomadic tents, fire pits, mountains, sands, and an abandoned village.
• Houses: Buy and furnish your home.
• Mobile: Apps, camera, banking, and money transfers.
• Groups and player marketplace.
• Day and night, on mobile, computer, and controller.
